_comment: Which extensions a new profile starts with, and where the app looks for them. Read at build time by scripts/prefetch-default-extensions.mjs and at first run by the desktop app. Marketplace extensions are distributed through https://github.com/Sarv/SarvInbox-extensions. The optional ClamAV extension is bundled from extensions/clamav-scan and installed only when the user connects antivirus during onboarding, or installs it manually.
